llm_toggle_hint: Turn the local AI's move commentary on or off. When off, the chosen move is still played, just without an explanation.
flip_board_hint: Check this if the board shown on screen is physically flipped (Black at the bottom). Some sites don't flip the display even when you play Black: uncheck it in that case.
app_title: ChessMate · your AI friend on every move
app_tagline: your AI friend on every move
calibrate_manual_hint: Automatic detection failed: drag a box around the board (right-click or Esc to cancel)
status_delay: Move found — playing it in a moment…
idle_hint: Calibrate the board if needed, pick your colour, then start the analysis.
err_autoplay: Move not confirmed on screen — resynchronising
llm_rule: Explain only the move given to you; never suggest a different move.
